label: Acyclic exercises and finite identity fibres exclude a return by backward lifting
meaning: Fix one q.3 a.4 profile, eligible exercise type, bearer map and exercise relation. Backward lifting composes over a nonempty finite actual esse-supplier path. In an inhabited finite identity fibre, acyclic exercise reachability is a strict transitive relation and has a minimal element. A bearer return lifts backwards from that element to a strict predecessor in the same fibre. Intermediate distinct-esse bearers require no finite fibre. The theorem uses no clock, global exercise well-foundedness, or premise that the bearer relation is exactly the existence-based projection.

strong_version_needed.9c717c08-4046-42d8-ae8b-763ef6b1b394: Finiteness supplies a minimal exercise in the inhabited eligible fibre under strict exercise reachability. The inhabited-fibre sibling alone only gives an exercise and does not give a minimal one.
